verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the dot can read and update documents through a connected Google Drive (dots-docs-11), work with local files via a connected computer (dots-docs-10), and keep a checklist updated (dots-docs-14). It can also delegate work to ChatGPT Work (dots-docs-13), and you can keep talking to it while it works, which suggests iterative refinement (dots-docs-1). However, none of the evidence says it creates new documents or presentations from scratch or exports files. Missing for 10: explicit document or presentation creation, export or download formats, a documented iterative editing workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
